recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add v3 ParticipationType back to Provenance.agent.type unless the Security WG opens a new terminology change that supersedes FHIR-32519 and the THO Provenance participant terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-17506 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked that Provenance.agent.type include HL7 v3 ParticipationType concepts while properly attributing the existing Provenance agent vocabulary to W3C PROV.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17506 was found. The active Provenance source now binds Provenance.agent.type to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/participation-role-type, and the relevant history shows the Security WG later applying the Provenance agent vocabulary through the participation-role-type value set rather than through a FHIR-17506-tagged change.
additional_context: FHIR-22494 later aligned Provenance.agent.type with AuditEvent.agent.type and ParticipationRoleType. FHIR-28218 corrected the moved Provenance participant value set canonical to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/provenance-agent-type. FHIR-32519 then explicitly changed Provenance.agent.type to a Preferred binding and directed removal of RoleCode, RoleClass, and ParticipationType from the value set, leaving only THO Provenance participant and DICOM Audit codes. The combined branch already has audit commits for FHIR-22494 and FHIR-32519.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active source is consistent with the later FHIR-32519 decision: Provenance.agent.type remains bound to participation-role-type, whose source composes THO provenance-agent-type and DICOM Audit codes and no longer includes v3 ParticipationType directly.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue aligned Provenance.agent.type with AuditEvent.agent.type and ParticipationRoleType; already represented on the combined branch.
